implementation_notes: Obstacle injection now happens after each LIBERO rollout reset, using a cached base MuJoCo XML to avoid duplicate obstacle bodies.
The obstacle eval runner records per-step conservative robot-obstacle clearance from geom center distance minus geom_rbound radii.
Scenario and overall summaries now include task success, safety success, avoidance success, collision count, clearance violations, min clearance, and mean episode-min clearance.
